description: Inflammation of the glans penis, sometimes involving the foreskin as balanoposthitis.
symptoms: Discharge may occur depending on cause
causes: Infectious and non-infectious inflammation, including Candida, bacteria, irritants, and dermatoses

appearance.general: Inflamed, reddened, irritated, or swollen glans, sometimes with erosions or discharge.

warning_signs: Severe swelling, inability to retract the foreskin, urinary difficulty, or a persistent ulcer or mass requires medical assessment.
general_first_aid: Gently wash with lukewarm water and dry the area carefully.
Avoid harsh soaps or fragranced products.
prevention: Gentle genital hygiene and careful drying after washing.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss diabetes risk, sexual exposure, recurrent episodes, and persistent lesions.
